title: Shell completion during a blocked write drops queued terminal tail and exit
trigger: Remote sends final bytes plus exit_status/close while an ordinary SSH write is suspended by flow control.
impact: write_and_drain returns false as soon as the lifecycle watch ends; pump and run_with_protocol drop the byte queues instead of draining final terminal output/Exited to the UI.
verification: Independently executed parent prebuilt stable binary, matching SHA256/inventory; no independent recompile.
